column1: # Game profile of EA SPORTS FC 27 (Switch). Bring-up profile of the research branch:
# identity, module list, memory and rewriter facts are from the extracted containers;
# shader key/PSO tables are included; derived runtime tables are generated locally.
# Historical bring-up evidence is in docs/research/fc27-bringup.md.
# EA's Frostbite engine on SDK 22.2.0 (the sdk module names NintendoSdk_nnSdk-22_2_0 and
# NintendoSDK_NVN-22_2_0), NVN. The game data lives in .toc / .cas pairs under Data/NX and
# Patch/NX. main is 221 MB of image (185.6 MB of text) with ZBIC-compressed segments, so the
# rewriter needs two patch areas (patch_nso.py BIG_TEXT): one before the base and one after
# the image, because no single AArch64 B reaches across 185.6 MB of text.
# Base and update carry different mains (c2a25633… / 9636bcd6…): the update is the one the
# game ships as its current version, the base row is kept because the base-only boot is the
# comparison baseline (docs/research/fc27-input-integrity-audit.md).
# ---- Identity ----
title_id

name
app_name
ipa
app_category
# a football game: both sticks, a D-pad and the four face buttons
pad_layout

# base game (CNMT v0, NACP 1.0.0) and update (CNMT v327680, NACP display string 1.8c.fd45 as stored)

fps_target
# ---- Memory ----
# The NPDM declares a 6 MiB system resource (main.npdm META +0x14), so virtual address memory
# is enabled (hle_svc.c GetInfo). Guest address-space partition is measured, not copied: see
# docs/research/fc27-bringup.md section 20.
# Frostbite asks VammManager for its virtual address memory in regions of 512 MB and less
# (main+0x17f9884: 661 regions live after a full match, 3.03 GiB reserved, 1.30 GiB of them
# mapped, packed up to the alias region's end). With the SDK 22.2.0 node area cut to 62 MB
# (sdk_patches.py) the regions need 3.5 GiB of alias region, and a request that fails is fatal
# to the engine (it writes through a null pointer at main+0x17f98c4, "Couldn't reserve
# memory"): 3.375 GiB dies 4 s after boot, 3.5 GiB boots and plays. SetHeapSize asks for
# 1.1875 GB (pool − used − 1.75 GB of virtual address memory); the guest thread stacks use
# 5 MiB of their region across 43 threads.
# 5.03 GiB in all: 16 MB of prefix, the 3.75 GiB alias region (0.25 GiB of margin over the
# 3.5 GiB measured), 64 MiB of stacks and a 1.25 GiB heap region.
mem_reserve
mem_prefix
mem_alias
mem_stack
app_pool
# main alone maps 16 MB (first patch area) + 233.5 MB (image incl. bss and key page) + the
# second patch area after the image; sdk adds about 12 MB. SetHeapSize checks the request
# against the loaded modules, so the used-memory figure has to cover them.
mem_used
sys_resource
